parser_note: Includes complete encoded instruction columns even when a10-byte instruction has no separator space before the tab.
normalization: Only author::visit→author::dispatch role correspondence, linked branch/call destination addresses and RIP comments are normalized. Registers, opcodes, memory operands and immediates remain. Four remaining RIP literal displacements are retained explicitly.
finding: All14 complete ordinary functions retain instruction counts;12 normalized op sequences match. The remaining two functions each differ only in four RIP-relative literal displacements.
